items.exampleEn: Many words in the local language come from the colonial period.
items.exampleZh: 當地語言裡有很多字來自殖民時期。

items.exampleEn: The car looks old outside, but its interior is clean and comfortable.
items.exampleZh: 那輛車外表看起來很舊，但內部乾淨又舒適。

items.exampleEn: The old arena will be turned into a large indoor market next year.
items.exampleZh: 那座舊體育館明年將改建成大型室內市場。

items.exampleEn: Space is often called the last frontier for human explorers.
items.exampleZh: 太空常被稱為人類探險者的最後邊疆。

items.exampleEn: Kids from neighboring villages walk to the same school.
items.exampleZh: 附近幾個村子的孩子走路去同一所學校。

items.exampleEn: The Arctic is covered in ice for most of the year.
items.exampleZh: 北極地區一年大部分時間都被冰覆蓋。
items.glossZh: 北極（地區）；北極的；極冷的

items.exampleEn: Please don't park your bike on the pavement outside the shop.
items.exampleZh: 請不要把腳踏車停在店門口的人行道上。
items.glossZh: 人行道；路面；（英式：人行道義）

items.exampleEn: The statewide music contest attracts students from over two hundred schools.
items.exampleZh: 這項全州音樂比賽吸引了兩百多所學校的學生參加。

items.sentenceEn: The interior of the old church is cool even in summer.
items.sentenceZh: 那座老教堂的內部即使在夏天也很涼爽。

items.audioEn: The arena opens at six, and the show starts at seven thirty, so let's have dinner first.
items.audioZh: 競技場六點開門，表演七點半開始，我們先吃晚餐吧。

items.sentenceEn: An arctic wind made the whole city feel like a freezer.
items.sentenceZh: 一陣極冷的寒風讓整座城市像冰庫一樣。

items.sentenceEn: Scientists are working at the frontier of medicine to find new treatments.
items.sentenceZh: 科學家正在醫學的最前線努力尋找新療法。

items.stemEn: The storm caused power cuts in our town and two ____ towns.
items.stemZh: 暴風雨造成我們鎮和鄰近兩個鎮停電。

items.stemEn: The ice on the ____ made walking to school very dangerous this morning.
items.stemZh: 今天早上人行道上結冰，走路上學非常危險。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my family took a road trip across Texas. In one small town, we visited a museum inside a colonial house, where the interior still had the original wooden floors and an old cello. The guide told us the town had once been on the frontier, and life there was hard. Next, we drove to a big arena to watch a football game, which was loud and exciting. The weather was extremely hot, and my sister joked that she wanted to move to the Arctic. On the last day, we learned that the state was running a statewide program to plant trees along the streets in its towns.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們全家開車橫越德州。在一個小鎮，我們參觀了一間設在殖民時期房屋裡的博物館，屋子內部還保留著原本的木地板和一把舊大提琴。導覽員說，這個小鎮以前位在邊疆，那裡的生活很辛苦。接著，我們開車到一座大型競技場看足球賽，場面熱鬧又刺激。天氣熱得要命，我的姊妹開玩笑說她想搬到北極去。最後一天，我們得知這個州正在推行一項全州計畫，要在各城鎮的街道旁種樹。

questions.questionZh: 導覽員說這個小鎮以前是什麼樣子？

items.promptZh: 這家飯店的室內設計很現代。
referenceEn: The interior design of this hotel is very modern.
This hotel has a very modern interior.
rubricZh: interior 指室內、內部（例如 the interior design、a modern interior）

items.promptZh: 從我家的窗戶，我們可以看到鄰近的山。
referenceEn: We can see the neighboring hills from our window.
From the window of our house, we can see the neighboring mountains.
rubricZh: neighboring 放在名詞前，表示「鄰近的」（例如 the neighboring mountains 等）
「山」可寫，例如 mountains、hills 等；「窗戶」單複數皆可
